column1: # The parts of speech Webster's Unabridged Dictionary (1913) writes after a headword's spelling, each as the dictionary
# writes it (n., v. t., a.). A noun, adjective, verb (transitive, intransitive or both), adverb, preposition, pronoun,
# conjunction or interjection is the part of speech of the shared vocabulary it names; every other category the
# dictionary writes (a participle, an inflected form, a plural, a prefix) is its own, kept as written and equivalent
